subject: Demo timing: need to shift due to CFO travel and spend pacing
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: tom.li@acme.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to move Redwood demo (Acme)

Hi Grace / Ben,

Quick update from my side — our CFO unexpectedly needs to travel to Asia the week of July 19 for a vendor review, so we won't have the executive presence for the product demo we scheduled for 7/20.

Procurement also signaled a short pause on new vendor approvals while they re-check Q3 spend pacing; they expect to have clarity in early August after the reforecast. Given that, would you be open to moving the full demo out by two weeks (targeting the week of Aug 2) or, alternatively, doing a 20-minute executive summary for leadership next week and pushing the procurement deep-dive until after the reforecast?

Attaching the internal agenda we planned to use so you can see who we intended to bring (agenda attached). If you have a succinct executive one-pager or slides, that might work for the short session.

Apologies for the shuffle — appreciate your flexibility.

Best,
Sara Jenkins
Head of AI Programs | Acme Corporation
Attachments: acme-demo-agenda.pdf
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, tom.li@acme.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move Redwood demo (Acme)

Thanks for the heads up, Sara — totally understand. We can absolutely flex here. Two options that have worked well:

1) Executive summary: 20–25 minute live briefing (exec-level slides + 2–3 customer examples) to keep momentum with the CFO next week; no procurement deep-dive required.
2) Full demo: move to week of Aug 2 for the full procurement + engineering walkthrough.

If you prefer the exec summary, I can propose three short slots next week (all times ET): Wed 7/15 11:00–11:30, Thu 7/16 14:00–14:30, Fri 7/17 10:00–10:30. We’ll include Ben for the product Q&A and Lauren for any contract/ops questions.

If you want to push to Aug, what days work best for Procurement (Tom) and the engineering lead? We’ll send a fresh invite and a short one-pager for the exec summary (attached).

Happy to be flexible — let me know which of the three short slots works or confirm week-of-Aug 2 windows and we’ll lock it.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198
Attachments: redwood-exec-summary.pptx

On Mon, Jul 13, 2026 at 09:12 AM Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com> wrote:

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move Redwood demo (Acme)

Hi Sara — appreciate the note. Couple quick thoughts from our side:

- Exec summary works really well to keep the CFO looped without pulling Procurement in; we can run a tight 20-minute session focused on cost/latency benefits and a 5-minute Q&A.
- If you’d prefer the full demo the week of Aug 2, we recommend Tue 8/3 or Wed 8/4 mornings ET to give your engineering and procurement folks time after the reforecast.

Lauren — can you confirm whether we should prepare any preliminary commercial terms/price band for the Aug session or hold off until Procurement reconvenes? If we prepare a conservative band we can move faster once they greenlight.

Thanks — happy to adapt.

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

On Mon, Jul 13, 2026 at 11:03 AM grace_oconnor@redwood.com wrote:
> Thanks for the heads up, Sara — totally understand. We can absolutely flex here...
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: tom.li@acme.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move Redwood demo (Acme)

Thanks, Grace and Ben — exec summary makes sense for now. We’ll confirm with the CFO but tentatively lock Wed 7/22 11:00–11:25 AM ET for a brief session; please send the calendar invite when you can.

Procurement will plan to re-engage the week of Aug 2 for the full technical walkthrough; Tom will coordinate availability next week once the reforecast is published.

If you can include a single-slide summary on expected unit economics (token cost per 1k, example throughput) that would be helpful for the CFO. Otherwise, we’ll wait for the full materials in August.

Appreciate you accommodating us on short notice.

Best,
Sara Jenkins
Head of AI Programs | Acme Corporation
